title: Nothing you can see changed: room for finished houses again
items: The town's published files had filled their size allowance again, which held back a finished Prairie Avenue house. The growth since 20 October is measured: mostly the period carriages and horses, and the houses rebuilt from their photographs.
The allowance is raised to fit, with the arithmetic that keeps the whole site inside its host's limit, and the two biggest ways to hand bytes back are measured for later.
